name: To Whom it May Concern
message: I am writing this letter to your office because we have sent requests two other times. You have offered coupons and FREE cigarettes, but nothing was ever sent. I don't know if you are confusing me with my brother, but we are two different people living in two different places. Now this is the 3rd time I'm sending this out. If I don't receive my FREE cigarettes OR coupons, you would be just a false company.
signature: Steve A. Pattison OR KAREN R. Pattison
